    - The lemon balm has taken, and the rose walk is gentler. Slow roots hold longest, *Player*.
    - Ah... a visitor. Good morning. Mind the roses; they are listening. I am **Godwin**, gardener here.

        - *Choice:* Tell me about the gardens.

    - I came to push a barrow for old Gerold in the year the old king was crowned. Fifty-eight summers, now.
    - A garden is only ever finished on the day the gardener is. So I keep at it. Young [Alaric](../npcs/alaric.md) helps, when he is gentle with the roses.
    - Below the terrace is the **kingdom border**: a cutting of every town's favourite flower, begged from envoys and carters over many years.
    - One place in it is still empty. I never learned what flowers in **Cavelor**, or whether anything does. I keep it weeded, in case someone tells me.
    - The wild bees have turned mean this year. Fifty-eight summers and never a sting in the rose walk. Four since spring. One on the eyelid.

    - Go gently. Slow roots hold longest.
